Get Account Groups Lite
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/accountGroups/lite

Retrieves the ID and name of all the AWS account groups. For additional details, use the GET /accountGroups method.

Responses
​
default

Default response. To learn more, see API Response Codes and Error Messages.

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
id
int32

The ID of the entity.

name
string

The name of the entity.

]
